ekit_testimonial_data.review: I've worked with James on several occasions, and each time, the experience has been excellent. From installing a new panel to troubleshooting electrical issues, he's consistently delivered high-quality work. Always punctual, professional, and efficient. I trust him with all my electrical needs. Highly recommended.

James with MVP has done several jobs for me including fixing can-lights, a garage door opener, diagnosing nonworking gfci outlets, installing light dimmer switches, and fixing an electric fireplace. With every job he has been professional and knowledgeable. I will happily continue to personally use his services and refer MVP Electric to my friends, family, and clients.
We love James! He's attentive, thorough, organized, patient with our requests, and capable. I need to make my next list of electric needs and have him return.

Showed up on time, diagnosed the problem and came back again to check on an appliance associated with the primary issue. All of the work was done in a timely manor and communicated throughout the project. Cost of project was appropriate for the work that was done.

I had the pleasure of working with James (MVP ELECTRIC).
James was knowledgeable and provided all the answers to my questions and that enabled me to reach a correct decision on what needs to be done and how it needs to be done. He was honest about what he told me and I got the feeling that he was looking after my interests.
His execution of the project was excellent, timely and exactly as he had conveyed upfront.

Will I use him again?
In a hear beat.
I am more than happy to recommend James (MVP).

James from MVP Electric was a pleasure to work with. He did the electrical work on whole home generator install at my home. James was very pleasant to work with, arrived on time, did the job quickly, was reasonably priced and did quality work that passed inspection the first time. I recommend James and intend to use him for any future electrical work.

James was super responsive and helpful addressing my wiring switch issue. He carefully and professionally explained his process in solving the issue, and the final price was reasonable for his valuable time. I highly recommend MVP Electric for any electrical jobs, large or small.

James installed a generator interlock system and ran conduit for a custom generator receptacle with excellent workmanship and attention to detail. His communication was clear, professional, and nearly instant, and it was obvious he knew his craft well. He was punctual, fair, and efficient, even troubleshooting and testing the system before leaving. Everything passed inspection, looks great, works perfectly, and I plan to hire him again. Highly recommended!

James Thorp installed a home Chargepoint EV charger for me. Very quick to respond - came out to assess the job same day. Emailed an estimate same day and completed the work just a few days later at my convenience. He included the charger and permit in his bid.
